The story states there are 10 total courses. Teacher Wang mentions "most" are science, "some" literature, and "hardly any" art. Liu finds 3 art classes, which aligns with "hardly any" (as 3 is a small number in a 10-course system). With 3 art classes, the remaining 7 courses are science and literature. For science to be "most," it must exceed half of the total (i.e., >5), so science must be at least 6. Since "some literature courses" implies at least 1 literature course, the only valid split is 6 science and 1 literature (6 + 1 + 3 = 10). Any higher science count (e.g., 7 or more) would require literature to be 0 or negative, which contradicts "some literature." Thus, Liu would guess 6 science classes.
